scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
Good day~
Let me invite you all
to my homeland, Kunlun.
It is my honor to guide
such distinguished quests from
the Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
您好~
让我邀请您前往我的故乡昆仑。
能引导来自卢恩·米德加兹王国的尊贵冒险者，是我的荣幸。

scripts.text: About Kunlun
scripts.translation: 关于昆仑

scripts.text: Visit Kunlun
scripts.translation: 前往昆仑

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
Kunlun is a beautiful place,
rich with history, and its
own traditions. I also think
Kunlun is the best place for
sightseeing.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
昆仑是一个美丽的地方，拥有丰富的历史和独特的传统。我也认为昆仑是观光的最佳地点。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
When you arrive at the harbor of
Kunlun, you'll be able to see
miniature replicas of
buildings found in Alberta
and Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
当您抵达昆仑港口时，您将能看到艾尔贝塔和普隆德拉建筑的微缩复制品。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
After enjoying a nice, leisurely
stroll, step into the beautiful
column of light that will take
you up into the clouds to
Kunlun Village.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
在悠闲地漫步之后，请踏入那道美丽的光柱，它将带您穿过云层，前往昆仑村庄。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
I've heard that on the
Rune-Midgarts continent,
there is another city that is
is kept aloft in the sky by
an ancient, mysterious power...
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
我听说在卢恩·米德加兹大陆上，还有另一座城市依靠古老而神秘的力量悬浮在空中……

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
Well, my Kunlun also floats
in the air, but without any
so called technology or
power supply. We consider
our land especially blessed...
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
嗯，我的昆仑也漂浮在空中，但没有任何所谓的科技或动力源。我们认为这片土地受到了特别的祝福……

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
When you're in Kunlun, don't
forget to try our specialties
such as the giant dumpling or the heaven peach.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
当您在昆仑时，别忘了尝尝我们的特产，比如巨型饺子和仙桃。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
You'd better prepare yourself
if you are planning to visit
the Kunlun dungeon. I must
say, that is not a safe place to go for fun.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
如果您计划前往昆仑地下城，最好做好心理准备。我必须说，那可不是一个适合去游玩的安全地方。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
If you are interested in visiting
Kunlun, do not hesitate to let
me know. It's my great pleasure
to serve you, honorable guest.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
如果您有兴趣访问昆仑，请随时告诉我。能为尊贵的客人服务是我的极大荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
Excellent choice, I am glad
to have you as our guest~
However, a small fee is required
to board the ship to Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
极好的选择，很高兴您能成为我们的客人~
不过，乘坐前往昆仑的船只需要支付少量费用。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
We ask that you pay 10,000 zeny
prior to departure. That fee also
covers the cost of returning
to Alberta. I am ready to guide
you to Kunlun at any time.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
我们要求您在出发前支付10,000泽尼。这笔费用也包含了返回艾尔贝塔的费用。我随时准备引导您前往昆仑。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
Would you like to board?
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
您想登船吗？

scripts.text: To Kunlun~!
scripts.translation: 去昆仑~！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
Thank you, let me guide you there immediately.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
谢谢，让我立即引导您前往。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
I am sorry, but you must have
10,000 zeny to travel to Kunlun.
Please make sure you have enough
zeny with you. Thank you, and
please come again.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
很抱歉，您必须有10,000泽尼才能前往昆仑。
请确保您身上有足够的泽尼。谢谢，欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
I see. However, whenever you
change your mind, please let
me know. It would be a great
please to serve you, most
honorable guest.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
我明白了。不过，无论您何时改变主意，请告诉我。能为最尊贵的客人服务将是我的极大荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
I see. However, whenever you
change your mind, please let me
know. It would be a great pleasure to serve you, most honorable guest.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
我明白了。不过，无论您何时改变主意，请告诉我。能为最尊贵的客人服务将是我的极大荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
So, did you enjoy your trip?
I guess it's the time for you to
go home. The ship to Rune-Midgarts is ready to depart at any time.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
那么，您的旅途愉快吗？
我想是时候让您回家了。前往卢恩·米德加兹的船只随时可以出发。

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
Please come again.
I hope you will let your friends
know about Kunlun when you get
back. Now, let me guide you
back to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
欢迎再次光临。
希望您回到家乡后能让朋友们知道昆仑这个地方。现在，让我引导您返回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text:
[Wa Bai Hu]
Take your time, my guest.
There should be many places
you may have missed.
scripts.translation:
[瓦白虎]
请慢慢来，我的客人。
应该还有很多您可能错过的地方。

scripts.text:
[Zhang Quing Long]
Please head north to enter Kunlun.
I hope you will have a great time
while staying in Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[张青龙]
请向北走以进入昆仑。
希望您在昆仑逗留期间玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Zhang Quing Long]
Please make yourself comfortable.
If you want to go back, I will
be more than happy to guide you
to the ship to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[张青龙]
请随意放松。
如果您想回去，我很乐意引导您前往前往艾尔贝塔的船只。

scripts.text: Go back to the harbor
scripts.translation: 返回港口

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Zhang Quing Long]
I hope you enjoyed your trip.
Now, let me guide you back
to the harbor.
scripts.translation:
[张青龙]
希望您享受这次旅行。
现在，让我引导您返回港口。

scripts.text:
[Zhang Quing Long]
Take your time, my guest.
There should be many places
you may have missed.
scripts.translation:
[张青龙]
请慢慢来，我的客人。
应该还有很多您可能错过的地方。

scripts.text:
[Jian Chung Xun]
I simply adore festivals.
That's why I love this town.
This town makes me feel like I am
in the middle of a festival all year round.
scripts.translation:
[简重勋]
我简直太喜欢节日了。
这就是我爱这个城镇的原因。
这个城镇让我感觉全年都沉浸在节日之中。

scripts.text:
[Liang Zhun Bu]
We are proud to be an independent
nation, and have been fighting
against the evil invaders who've
wanted to conquer this blessed land for many years...
scripts.translation:
[梁准步]
我们为成为一个独立的国家而感到自豪，多年来一直在对抗那些想要征服这片福地的邪恶入侵者……

scripts.text:
[Liang Zhun Bu]
But we have victoriously fended
off every invasion! As long
as we believe in ourselves,
we shall never forget the
Triumphal Song that has helped us in our struggles.
scripts.translation:
[梁准步]
但我们胜利地击退了每一次入侵！只要我们相信自己，就永远不会忘记在斗争中帮助我们的《凯旋之歌》。

scripts.text:
[Qian Yuen Shuang]
The chief of this town is a man
who opens his heart to others.
However, I have heard that there
are some people who don't like his personality...
scripts.translation:
[钱远霜]
这个城镇的首领是一个敞开心扉待人的人。
不过，我听说有些人不喜欢他的性格……

scripts.text:
[Qian Yuen Shuang]
Well, I like my town. The Chief's
efforts have made our town safer.
I just hope other people feel the
same way about what he has done.
scripts.translation:
[钱远霜]
嗯，我喜欢我的城镇。首领的努力使我们的城镇更加安全。
我只希望其他人对他所做的一切也有同样的感受。

scripts.text:
[Jing Wen Zhen]
The men in our town, Kunlun, are
all brave and courageous.
But, they are unable to get
married. It's quite a shame really...
scripts.translation:
[景文真]
我们昆仑镇的男子都是勇敢无畏的。
但是，他们无法结婚。这真的很遗憾……

scripts.text:
[Jing Wen Zhen]
It's all because there are
more men than women.
I am not even sure whether
or not my son will be able to
find me a daughter in law.
scripts.translation:
[景文真]
这都是因为男性比女性多。
我甚至不确定我的儿子能否为我找到一个儿媳妇。

scripts.text:
[Kunlun Guard]
Welcome.
This is the residence of Shi Yan Wen, the chief of Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[昆仑卫兵]
欢迎。
这里是昆仑首领石延文的住所。

scripts.text:
[Kunlun Guard]
You better behave yourself while
you are here. If we see anything
suspicious, we'll arrest you in a heartbeat.
scripts.translation:
[昆仑卫兵]
你在这里最好规矩点。如果我们看到任何可疑行为，会立刻逮捕你。

scripts.text:
[Kunlun Guard]
However, rest assured, you seem
like a trustworthy person.
I'm sure nothing will happen. Enjoy your visit.
scripts.translation:
[昆仑卫兵]
不过，请放心，你看起来是个值得信赖的人。
我相信不会发生什么事。祝您参观愉快。

scripts.text:
[Kunlun Guard]
Welcome.
This is the residence of Shi Yan Wen, the chief of Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[昆仑卫兵]
欢迎。
这里是昆仑首领石延文的住所。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

不过，请放心，你看起来是个值得信赖的人。
我相信不会发生什么事。祝您参观愉快。

scripts.text:
[Ji Chung Zhe]
............

[Ji Chung Zhe]
puuuuu....This sure is
something to worry about.
scripts.translation:
[季忠哲]
噗……这真是让人忧心啊。

scripts.text:
[Ji Chung Zhe]
I am Ji Chung Zhe, a renown brewer
of teas. Everyday, I put all my
efforts in making scrumptious, delicious tea.
scripts.translation:
[季忠哲]
我是季忠哲，一位著名的茶艺师。每天，我都全力以赴制作美味可口的茶。

scripts.text:
[Ji Chung Zhe]
*Sigh* But lately, the tea I've
been making hasn't been that
great... If I only had some special ingredients...
scripts.translation:
[季忠哲]
*叹气* 但最近，我泡的茶味道不太理想……如果我有一些特殊的原料就好了……

scripts.text:
[Ji Chung Zhe]
I've been told that if you use
a snake, you can concoct a truly
extraordinary beverage~
But...where can I find one
and how can I catch one?
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[季忠哲]
有人告诉我，如果使用蛇，可以调制出真正非凡的饮料~
但是……我在哪里能找到它，又该如何捕捉它呢？
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Yu Jiu Xia]
Geez, just as I thought.
They won't sell alcohol to me.
Maybe its cuz I'm too young...
Hmmm...I wonder how it tastes...
scripts.translation:
[于九霞]
哎呀，正如我所料。
他们不卖酒给我。
也许是因为我太年轻了……
嗯……我想知道那是什么味道……

scripts.text:
[Yu Jiu Xia]
However, I know they're making
some tasty tea that even kids
like me can enjoy.
It makes my mouth water just
thinking about this new tea.
scripts.translation:
[于九霞]
不过，我知道他们在制作一些连像我这样的小孩都喜欢的美味茶水。
光是想到这种新茶，我就流口水了。

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
Let me tell you something
interesting about this place~
Long ago, this entire area used to be a shrine.
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
让我告诉你一些关于这个地方的趣事~
很久以前，整个区域曾经是一座神龛。

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
In those days, Taoist hermits
used to gather here in order to
reach the Sky Kingdom. However,
they failed miserably...slowly the monsters began to come...
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
在那个时候，恶云仙人聚集在这里，试图到达天空王国。然而，他们惨败……慢慢地，魔物开始出现了……

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
Don't you think it was quite noisy
last night? It was all because
of that thief. He made quite
a scene...It was so loud that
I couldn't sleep at all...
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
你不觉得昨晚很吵吗？全都是因为那个盗贼。他闹出了很大的动静……声音太大，我根本睡不着……

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
Ahh~~~~!
In the middle of all that
commotion, I saw
something running straight
into the shrine.
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
啊~~~~！
在那片混乱之中，我看到
某物径直跑进了神龛。

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
It was moving so fast that
I couldn't even tell what it was.
From what I could recognize, it
looked human. I wonder
what it was...
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
它移动得太快了，我甚至看不清它是什么。
从我能辨认出的情况来看，它看起来像人类。我想知道那是什么……

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
It might have been the
thief, but it moved
so fast, it seemed like
just a blur.
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
那可能是盗贼，但它移动
得太快了，看起来就像
一道模糊的影子。

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
Let me tell you something
interesting~ This entire area
used to be a shrine.
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
让我告诉你一些有趣的事~
整个区域曾经是一座神龛。

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
A long time ago, Taoist hermits
used to gather here in order to
reach the Sky Kingdom. However,
they failed miserably...slowly the monsters began to come.
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
很久以前，恶云仙人聚集在这里，试图到达天空王国。然而，他们惨败……慢慢地，魔物开始出现了。

scripts.text:
[Wa Qiu Wu]
The town is getting ready for the
Festival, but something is delaying
it. This has never happened before...
scripts.translation:
[瓦秋武]
城镇正在为节日做准备，但有些事情延误了进程。这种情况以前从未发生过……

scripts.text:
[Li Xi Jiao]
Welcome to Kunlun!
Did you enjoy all the incredible
scenery on your way here?
The buildings may be small, but we
all worked hard to build this city.
scripts.translation:
[李熙娇]
欢迎来到昆仑！
你在来的路上欣赏了那些令人惊叹的风景吗？
虽然建筑物很小，但我们大家都努力建设了这座城市。

scripts.text:
[Li Xi Jiao]
I have some miniatures of
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
You can view all of Prontera in a
single glance. The craftsmanship
on these masterpieces is quite stunning!
scripts.translation:
[李熙娇]
我有一些卢恩·米德加兹王国的微缩模型。
你可以一眼览尽整个普隆德拉。这些杰作的工艺相当惊人！

scripts.text:
[Li Xi Jiao]
If you look around carefully,
You'll find all sorts of beautiful
sights throughout the town.
scripts.translation:
[李熙娇]
如果你仔细环顾四周，
你会在整个城镇中发现各种美丽的景色。
